servinfo.title: Blind spot monitor indicator light (left / right) do not come ON with ignition “ON”

item.ptxt: Blind spot monitor system is controlled by blind spot monitor control module communicating with the following control modules through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.
It is necessary to remove the rear bumper for visual inspection of the blind spot monitor control module.
